item.title: Tuesday Creston Police Report
item.description: The Creston Police Department reported one incident in their Tuesday report. 37 year old Kyla Michelle Harris was cited for animal at large. The police reports state Harris failed to control a dog which jumped a fence and attacked a neighbor’s dogs. There have been several reports on multiple occasions.
